name: evolve
description: Agent procedural-memory and self-improvement primitive. Agents learn reusable skills and improve them from recorded outcomes, but every behaviour-changing self-modification (promote/retire) is risk-gated with a single-use human-approval nonce and recorded in a tamper-evident chain-hashed change log.

invocation.bridge_note: Pure bash — no separate binary. Reuses guardian's approval-nonce protocol and audit's chain-hash. The one pure-compute kernel (skill scoring, Wilson lower bound) is specified for Zero in spec/skill_score.0; this bridge holds the reference implementation.

signing.manifest_sha256: UNSIGNED in source — cosign sign-blob runs in CI at publish time

tools.name: evolve_skill_propose
tools.title: Propose a Skill
tools.description: Propose a new reusable skill (a named, triggered procedure the agent learned). Stored in pending state — no behaviour change yet, so this is SAFE. An active skill of the same name must be retired first; active behaviour never changes without the approval gate.

trigger.description: UNTRUSTED. When this skill applies. ASCII printable, max 256 chars.

steps.description: UNTRUSTED. 1-32 procedure steps, each an ASCII-printable string up to 512 chars.

rationale.description: UNTRUSTED. Why the agent learned this. ASCII printable, max 512 chars.

actor.description: Who is proposing (agent/user id). ASCII printable, max 256 chars.

tools.name: evolve_skill_promote
tools.title: Promote a Skill (gated self-modification)
tools.description: Activate a pending skill. This changes the agent's active behaviour, so it is classified HIGH: the first call returns decision_required:true plus a single-use approval_nonce. Call again with the nonce as human_acknowledgment_token after human sign-off to activate. The transition is appended to the tamper-evident change log.

name.description: Name of the pending skill to activate.

actor.description: Who is promoting. ASCII printable, max 256 chars.

human_acknowledgment_token.description: Nonce from a prior promote response, after human sign-off. Single-use, 5-min TTL, bound to this action+skill.

tools.name: evolve_skill_retire
tools.title: Retire a Skill (gated self-modification)
tools.description: Deactivate an active skill. Like promote, this changes active behaviour and is gated: first call returns decision_required:true and an approval_nonce; call again with the nonce as human_acknowledgment_token to retire. Recorded in the tamper-evident change log.

name.description: Name of the active skill to retire.

actor.description: Who is retiring. ASCII printable, max 256 chars.

human_acknowledgment_token.description: Nonce from a prior retire response, after human sign-off. Single-use, 5-min TTL, bound to this action+skill.

tools.name: evolve_skill_record_outcome
tools.title: Record a Skill Outcome
tools.description: Record a success or failure for a skill use. Updates the skill's success/failure counts and recomputes its confidence score (Wilson lower bound). This is the improve-during-use signal; it never changes a skill's state, so it is SAFE.

name.description: Name of the skill the outcome is for.

actor.description: Who is reporting. ASCII printable, max 256 chars.

tools.name: evolve_skill_list
tools.title: List Skills
tools.description: List skills in the registry, optionally filtered by state. Read-only and SAFE. Returns each skill with its state, success/failure counts, and confidence score.

state.description: Optional filter: pending, active, or retired.

tools.name: evolve_skill_recommend
tools.title: Recommend Skills
tools.description: Rank active skills for the current situation by confidence score (then successes, then name). Pure-compute selection — read-only and SAFE. Returns the ranked list and the top pick; the agent still gates any action it takes via guardian.

trigger.description: Optional context hint. ASCII printable, max 256 chars.

tools.name: evolve_skill_get
tools.title: Get a Skill
tools.description: Fetch a single skill by name, including its steps, state, counts, and score. Read-only and SAFE.

tools.name: evolve_memory_note
tools.title: Record a Memory Note
tools.description: Persist a learning note (a model of the user/context that deepens across sessions). Notes are data only — never auto-executed — and are stored in the tamper-evident change log. SAFE.

note.description: UNTRUSTED. The note text. ASCII printable, max 1024 chars.

actor.description: Who is noting. ASCII printable, max 256 chars.

tools.name: evolve_history
tools.title: Read Change History
tools.description: Return the tamper-evident change log (newest first) and verify the chain. Returns valid:false with broken_at_entry:N if any entry was altered or deleted. Read-only and SAFE.

INVALID_INPUT.fix: Check field values against schema constraints (charset, length, enum).

SKILL_NOT_FOUND.fix: Propose the skill first, or check the name.

INVALID_ACKNOWLEDGMENT_TOKEN.fix: Re-run the gated tool without a token to obtain a fresh approval_nonce.

STORE_WRITE_FAILED.fix: Retry; check disk/permissions for the data dir.

UNKNOWN_TOOL.fix: Use one of the eight evolve_* tools.

security.content_policy: Tool descriptions audited against mcp-security-spec.md. No instruction-format language. Every description <= 512 chars.
security.self_modification_gate: promote and retire change active agent behaviour and require a single-use, action+skill-bound human-approval nonce (5-min TTL). Every transition is chain-hash logged.
security.data_charset: All user-facing string fields are ASCII-printable-only (0x20-0x7E), length-bounded, and charset-validated — rejecting control chars and non-ASCII bytes.

agent_quickstart: 1. evolve_skill_propose a skill learned from experience (stored pending — no behaviour change).
2. evolve_skill_promote it: the first call returns decision_required:true and an approval_nonce.
3. After human sign-off, call evolve_skill_promote again with human_acknowledgment_token:<nonce> to activate.
4. As the skill is used, evolve_skill_record_outcome success/failure; the confidence score updates automatically.
5. evolve_skill_retire (also gated) a skill that stops working; propose a revision and re-promote.
6. evolve_history any time to read and cryptographically verify the full self-improvement trail.
